title: aUEC job order
description: An AUEC order of the member's set: the fields of every job order and the requester-facing progress in whole aUEC. It carries no contact, no holder and no amount per person; everything about money happens in the Basetool through link.

netHandedOver.description: The net amount handed over to the requester in whole aUEC.

remaining.description: The target less the net handover, never below 0.

overpaid.description: The net handover beyond the target, never below 0.

settlementOpen.description: A closed order still holds purpose-bound funds or an overpayment; it is settled in the Basetool. No amount is carried.
